Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the oil cooler inspection which must be performed every 
 2000 hours of operation
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Khalil darwish reviewed & 
 tested by eng. Sobhy Tolba Ahmed at 1 March 2009, accepted by eng. Abdel Fatah 
 Mohamed Shehata approved by eng. Gomaa Khater khadr: head sector of Kafr 
 Eldawar power station
The high pressure heater technical data
Number of cooler :4
Size of cooler surface : 64 m2
Max. temperature of cooling water : 30 c
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area
Wear safety and healthy 
 equipments as safety healthy, shoes, ...etc.
Equip. item | Safety steps | Position
Disconnect | Open | Closed
Manual | Inlet water valve |  |  | x
Manual | Outlet water valve |  |  | x
Manual | Inlet oil valve |  |  | x
Manual | Outlet oil valve |  |  | x
Manual | Drain oil valve |  | x | 
Manual | Drain water water |  | x | 
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Main crane, temporary wood
Standard bolt drivers set
Measurement tools
Work to be 
carried out
Be sure the pipeline is drained
Open cooler bolt
Inspect gasket and replace with a 
 new gasket if necessary
Inspect coil leakage by pressurized 
 the shell and blocked any coil leaks
Clean cooler by chemical reaction
Close cooler
